Commentary.Commentary: Netherlands did well to halt the run-flow in the middle overs. They took some brilliant catches as well and just when it seemed like they will be able to keep the Windies under 300, the stand between Powell and Samuels just killed all those hopes. It's now on their batters to do the job and one would hope that they will come out fighting. It is a must-win encounter for them if they want to keep their hopes alive to reach the next round. Stay tuned for the run chase...

Big score by the Windies. However, Netherlands will be happy that they pulled things back. After being put into bat first, Windies got off to a flyer. As there were showers predicted during the game, we had to go in and out twice because of which the match was reduced to 48-overs-a-side. The way Gayle and Lewis started off the proceedings, it looked like they are here for business. But Netherlands got an opening which saw the former making way for Hetmyer. The newcomer couldn't last long and Windies kept losing wickets at regular junctures.

Windies captain, Jason Holder says that they would have loved to bowl as well. Adds that they have been batting first in last few games and are confident with the bat. Reckons that they will look to put some run on board and hopes that some of their batsmen will come back in form. Ends by saying that there are no changes to the playing XI.

Netherlands captain, Peter Borren starts by saying that since it is a bit overcast they will have a go with the ball first. Since net run rate is the key to their qualification, they need to play good cricket today and give their best. Adds that winning the toss was crucial today and reckons that their batting has not been good on this wicket but will try their best to restrict the opposition. They would hope that their batsmen step up to the occasion. Ends that they have quite some changes to the playing XI but unfortunately doesn't remember the names.
TOSS - Jason Holder flips the coin and heads is the call from Peter Borren. It lands in the latter's favour, NETHERLANDS WIN THE TOSS AND THEY WILL BOWL FIRST.

After registering a victory over Ireland in their previous encounter, Windies have made it to the next stage. Netherlands, on the other hand, lie at the second spot from bottom with just a single win in their 3 matches. Hello and welcome to the Harare Sports Club, Harare for the clash between Windies and Netherlands, which is also their last game of the group stages. With a win today, Netherlands still have a chance to qualify on the basis of the run rate. Will we see Windies dominate yet another game in the group stages or will Netherlands still keep their hopes alive with a win today? Stay tuned as we bring you the toss and teams shortly.
